t_advice_summary_textbox.text: They told me to find which color gives the most and stick to it.

vb_textbox.text: Each round, pick a color and if it gives a good amount stick to those same colors until it starts to get low. When it starts to give low amounts, change to the opposite color and do the same thing. For example, if there is a red and blue gnome and you pick the blue one, if it gives over 5 when the multiplier is x1 or over 25 when x5, stick with blue. If it gives less, change to the red gnome. When i did this i had a good amount of points.
